# Game Idea: **Astro Dash**

- **Genre:** Endless arcade/avoidance.
- **Core Loop:** The player pilots a small ship on an HTML canvas, constantly moving forward. Asteroids and debris scroll toward the ship.
- **Controls:** Arrow keys (or WASD) to thrust up/down/left/right.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible, racking up distance.
- **Lose Condition:** The ship crashes into any obstacle or exits the canvas bounds.

*Simple graphics and physics make it easy to implement with Canvas 2D.*

1: // Astro Dash - simple endless canvas game
2: // Assumes an existing <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
8:   // Sound assets
9:   const thrustSound = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ericfischer/asteroids-sfx/thrust.wav');
10:   const crashSound = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ericfischer/asteroids-sfx/crash.wav');
11:   const bgMusic = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ericfischer/asteroids-sfx/background.mp3');
12:   bgMusic.loop = true;
13:   bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
14:   // Start music after first user interaction (key press)
15:   let musicStarted = false;
16: 
17:   // Ship
18:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 60, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 4 };
19: 
20:   // Obstacles
21:   const obstacles = [];
22:   const obstacleSpawnRate = 90; // frames
23:   // Starfield
24:   const stars = [];
25:   const starCount = 100;
26:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
27:     stars.push({
28:       x: Math.random() * width,
29:       y: Math.random() * height,
30:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
31:       speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
32:     });
33:   }
34:   let frameCount = 0;
35:   let score = 0;
36:   let gameOver = false;
37: 
38:   // Input handling
39:   const keys = {};
40:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
41:     keys[e.key] = true;
42:     // Start background music on first interaction
43:     if (!musicStarted) {
44:       musicStarted = true;
45:       bgMusic.play();
46:     }
47:     // Play thrust sound when moving up
48:     if ((e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') && !thrustSound.paused) {
49:       // already playing
50:     } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') {
51:       thrustSound.currentTime = 0;
52:       thrustSound.play();
53:     }
54:   });
55:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
56: 
57:   function spawnObstacle() {
58:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
59:     obstacles.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 3 });
60:   }
61: 
62:   function update() {
63:     if (gameOver) return;
64:     // Move ship
65:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ship.y -= ship.speed;
66:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ship.y += ship.speed;
67:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.x -= ship.speed;
68:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.x += ship.speed;
69:     // Keep within bounds
70:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
71:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y));
72: 
73:     // Update starfield (scroll downwards)
74:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
75:       const s = stars[i];
76:       s.y += s.speed;
77:       if (s.y > height) {
78:         s.y = 0;
79:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
80:       }
81:     }
82: 
83:     // Spawn obstacles
84:     if (frameCount % obstacleSpawnRate === 0) spawnObstacle();
85:     frameCount++;
86: 
87:     // Update obstacles
88:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
89:       const o = obstacles[i];
90:       o.y += o.speed;
91:       // Remove off‑screen
92:       if (o.y > height) {
93:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
94:         score++;
95:       }
96:     }
97: 
98:     // Collision detection
99:     for (const o of obstacles) {
100:       if (ship.x < o.x + o.w && ship.x + ship.w > o.x && ship.y < o.y + o.h && ship.y + ship.h > o.y) {
101:         gameOver = true;
102:         // Play crash sound and stop music
103:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
104:         crashSound.play();
105:         bgMusic.pause();
106:         break;
107:       }
108:     }
109:   }
110: 
111:   function draw() {
112:     // Clear and draw background
113:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
115:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
116:     // Draw stars
117:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
118:     for (const s of stars) {
119:       ctx.beginPath();
120:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
121:       ctx.fill();
122:     }
123:     // Draw ship (gradient triangle with thrust)
124:     const shipGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
125:     shipGradient.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
126:     shipGradient.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
127:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGradient;
128:     ctx.beginPath();
129:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
130:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
131:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
132:     ctx.closePath();
133:     ctx.fill();
134:     // Thrust flame when moving up
135:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) {
136:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
137:       ctx.beginPath();
138:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
139:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2 - 5, ship.y + ship.h + 10);
140:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2 + 5, ship.y + ship.h + 10);
141:       ctx.closePath();
142:       ctx.fill();
143:     }
144:     // Obstacles - draw as gradient circles
145:     for (const o of obstacles) {
146:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2, o.w/4, o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2, o.w/2);
147:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff6b6b');
148:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#c0392b');
149:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
150:       ctx.beginPath();
151:       ctx.arc(o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2, o.w/2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     }
154:     // Score
155:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
156:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
157:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
158:     if (gameOver) {
159:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
160:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
161:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
162:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
163:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
164:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
165:     }
166:   }
167: 
168:   function loop() {
169:     update();
170:     draw();
171:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
172:   }
173: 
174:   loop();
175: })();

(End of file - total 175 lines)
</content>
